description.en:
Plays a motion on an object (character, camera, effect model...) by name, e.g. "01" or a Shift-JIS name such as 立ち01 (standing). mode: the scripts pass 0 for most character motions, 3 for camera and effect animations, sometimes 1 or 2 (the values were not traced further). frames: the transition length in frames (default 30; the scripts often pass 0 for an immediate change).
The name must be a string: ev42052200 passes a number (CMND_SET_MOTION(hRyuuzakiH, 61, 3, 3)), which does not give a name.

true once requested.
null if the object is not found or has no motion, the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: A camera animation (real usage, from ev44010001.nut)
